annotations.title: Get RPL qualification and conditional quote

description: Read qualification requirements, risks, sources, public providers and RPL/gap/online prices by exact slug. Optional selections produce an indicative quote; missing choices remain explicit. Gap subtotal excludes extra interview/placement fees. Set includeProviderIdentity=true to identify the issuing school for an offering; this requires account authorization on the public endpoint. Never infer hidden school identities or treat a candidate as approved. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

gapUnits.description: Assessed gap units; requires gap pathway and providerPublicId. Do not guess.

includeProviderIdentity.description: Set true when the user asks which school issues an RPL qualification or which RTO supplies a quote. Returns issuing school names and RTO numbers matched to each offering. Requires a connected One U Education account on the public endpoint; authenticated company services can read directly. Defaults to false for public course and price queries.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

residency.description: resident = PR/citizen; nonResident = temporary visa holder in Australia; offshore = outside Australia. Never infer a missing identity.

slug.description: Exact slug returned by search_rpl_qualifications, not a qualification code.
